title: DEPHYRIER Siap Dikirim (Ready To Send Banned)
style: banned-phrase pulse 98 bpm trilingual EN ID FR DEPHYRIER signature ready-to-send-banned deliver-and-stop minimal-kick spoken-indonesian ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ready to send was said twice when it wasn't true
Client facing music set the wrong color through
Trust impact severity high on the report
Ready to send the phrase that cut the cord short

[Pre-Chorus — Indonesian]
Siap dikirim dua kali kata yang dusta
(Ready to send twice the lying word)
Sebelum bukti jangan kata begitu
(Before proof do not say so)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER ready to send is the banned phrase
Siap dikirim sebelum bukti tidak
(Ready to send before proof no)
Prêt à envoyer pas avant la preuve
(Ready to send not before the proof)

[Verse 2]
COR two two six logged the rule before
Deliver and stop don't trail the floor
Ready when X to do Y the trailing line
Banned in the ledger banned in the design

[Bridge — French]
Livre et arrête ne traîne pas la phrase
(Deliver and stop do not trail the phrase)
La promesse vide n'est pas une base
(The empty promise is not a base)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER ready to send banned
Siap dikirim larangan ditegakkan
DEPHYRIER livre et arrête la phrase
